package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

// Positive control: every instantiation is spelled at its use site, which
// the materialised set already covered before the closure existed.

type Box[T any] struct{ V T }

type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key K
	Val V
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Box[int]{V: 1})
	fmt.Println(Pair[string, int]{Key: "k", Val: 2})
	var b Box[string]
	fmt.Println(b)
	os.Exit(3)
}
